text:
The plate holds two avocado wedges, each roughly a quarter of an avocado, with the skin still on and some flesh eaten or scooped out.

A whole avocado has about 200 g of flesh, so a quarter is about 50 g of flesh. The wedges look partly eaten and the flesh appears browned, so I estimate about 35 g of flesh each. That makes roughly 70 g of flesh, plus skin.

The skin is probably inedible, but the question asks for the food on the plate. I count the edible flesh, about 70 g. Avocado has about 1.6 kcal per gram, so 70 g comes to about 112 kcal.

Including the skin would bring the mass to about 90 g. I report the flesh only, so I round to about 110 kcal and 70 g.

{"kcal": 110, "mass_g": 70}
